hook: Emad Mostaque founded Stability AI in 2019 and turned it into the company behind Stable Diffusion, the open-weight image model that pushed generative AI into public use in August 2022. A former hedge fund manager, he positioned Stability AI as a counterweight to closed AI labs, backing open releases rather than gating models behind an API. He resigned as CEO and left the board in March 2024, saying he wanted to pursue decentralized AI outside a single company, and by late 2024 Stability AI confirmed he no longer had any control over it.

quick_facts: Founded Stability AI and was appointed a company director on November 4, 2019, per UK Companies House records
Served as Stability AI's Chief Executive Officer and a company director from November 2019 until his resignation in March 2024
Born in Jordan in April 1983 and holds British nationality, per UK Companies House officer records
Educated at the University of Oxford, per Wikidata (QID Q114049362)
Backed and released Stable Diffusion, the open-weight text-to-image model published in August 2022
Confirmed by Stability AI in October 2024 to no longer control the company he founded
